description: The panel, plus opening a URL in the default browser. Still no filesystem and no shell. open-url is the narrowest useful capability there is: it hands a link to the browser and can do nothing else, and the page restricts it to http and https before it is ever called. Two more schemes, each one exact: ms-settings: and microsoft.windows.camera: (the fixed list of Windows targets in open_url, which the default scope - http, https, mailto, tel - refused). Music opens YouTube, which is https.
